scientific_integrity: All state and edge enumerations are exhaustive and reproducible from two standalone standard-library Python programs using different graph presentations. There is no claim of independent external validation, priority certification, or a general theorem for larger instances.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification for the twenty-vertex Desargues graph alone; the enumeration cannot be extrapolated to higher-dimensional middle levels. Unindexed publications may contain equivalent finite calculations. The general existence of Hamilton cycles and the number of states may be known; the claimed mathematical content is the length-ten flip reachability and its exact graph structure.
title: Six Sylow-five squares in a Desargues Hamilton-cycle flip graph
